blocks.source: 【RPGレビュー】ブレスオブファイア２
様々な種族が入り交じる世界が舞台の王道ＲＰＧ。竜族の血を引く主人公のリュウ、犬人間のボッシュなど、仲間キャラクターに純粋な人間は１人もいない。
blocks.translation: This classic RPG is set in a world where various races intermingle. Among the party members—including Ryu, the protagonist who carries the blood of the dragon clan, and Bosch, a dog-man—there is not a single ordinary human.

blocks.source: リュウはＤＱ型のセリフが無い主人公であるが、仲間キャラクターはそれなりに喋る。前作と比較すると、仲間のセリフが充実しており、イベントでは連れているメンバーによって会話内容が変化する。
blocks.translation: Ryu is a Dragon Quest-style silent protagonist, but the other party members speak to a reasonable extent. Compared to the previous game, the party members have much more dialogue, and the conversations in events change depending on which members are accompanying you.

blocks.source: ややコミカルな雰囲気が特徴で、ちょっとしたお使いイベントにもユーモアが見られる。また、終盤はシリアスな場面も多く見られるなど、ギャップが魅力。派手さは無いが、筆者が個人的に「こういう雰囲気の作品が作りたい」と思っている中の１つ。
blocks.translation: The game is characterized by its somewhat comical atmosphere, with humor even appearing in minor errand events. The latter part also contains many serious scenes, making this contrast one of its charms. It is not flashy, but it is one of the games that makes me personally think, “I want to create something with this kind of atmosphere.”

blocks.source: エンディングは２種類存在する。ベストエンドの条件は普通にやると、気付かない可能性もあるので注意が必要。というか、筆者はクリアから１０年以上もその存在に気付かず、姉に見せてもらった時はそのぶっ飛び気味の内容を含めて驚愕した。
blocks.translation: There are two endings. Be careful, as you may not notice the conditions for the best ending if you simply play normally. In fact, I did not realize it existed for more than ten years after clearing the game, and I was astonished when my older sister showed it to me—including its rather outrageous content.

blocks.source: ノーマルエンドの内容も、ハッピーエンドでは無いかもしれないが見る価値はあるように思う。
blocks.translation: The normal ending may not be a happy ending, but I think its content is still worth seeing.

blocks.source: オーソドックスなＲＰＧ。戦闘は斜め視点だが、システム的には普通のターン制。主人公リュウは『竜変身』の能力を持っており、ＭＰを全て消費するが威力は非常に強力。ボス戦では、この能力の使用がカギとなる。
blocks.translation: A conventional RPG. Battles are viewed from an angled perspective, but system-wise they use a standard turn-based format. The protagonist Ryu possesses the Dragon Transformation ability. It consumes all of his MP, but its power is extremely high. Using this ability is key in boss battles.

blocks.source: 今作で最も特徴的な要素として『合体』が挙げられる。旅先で出会ったシャーマンと仲間を合体させることで、強化することができる。相性が良い組み合わせならば、能力が大幅に強化され、姿も変化する『究極合体』になる。ただし、瀕死（最大ＨＰの１／４）になると合体は解除されてしまうので、扱い辛い部分も。
blocks.translation: The most distinctive feature of this game is Fusion. By fusing party members with shamans encountered during the journey, you can strengthen them. With a compatible combination, they become an Ultimate Fusion, greatly enhancing their abilities and changing their appearance. However, fusion is undone when the character becomes critically wounded (at 1/4 of their maximum HP), which can make it difficult to use.

blocks.source: 他には『釣り』『狩り』や人を集めて、町を発展させる『共同体』などの寄り道要素も存在する。共同体では世界各地から住人を連れてくることで、様々な施設が利用できるようになる。住人候補は世界中に数十人いるが、内６人しか連れてくることはできない上に、一度連れて来た住人を入れ替えることはできないので悩ましい。
blocks.translation: There are also optional diversions such as Fishing, Hunting, and the Township, where you gather people and develop a town. In the Township, bringing residents from around the world allows you to use various facilities. There are several dozen potential residents across the world, but you can bring only six of them, and once you have brought someone there, you cannot replace them, making the choice difficult.

blocks.source: 難易度はやや高めだが、格別、難しいという程でもない。分類としてはＤＱ的な基本を抑えた手堅い作り。ただし、途中、特定の仲間キャラ１人で戦闘しなければならないイベントが複数あるので、普段使用していないキャラがいる場合は詰まることがある。
blocks.translation: The difficulty is somewhat high, but not exceptionally difficult. In terms of classification, it is a solidly designed game built around Dragon Quest-style fundamentals. However, there are several events during which you must fight with one specific party member, so you may get stuck if there are characters you do not normally use.

blocks.source: 寄り道要素がそれなりに充実している作品であるが、期間限定など、行動次第では二度と手に入らない物が多い。下手をすると、主人公の最強武器や空の乗物が入手できなくなるのは非常に困ったものだ。ちなみに、この乗物の入手はベストエンドの条件でもある。
blocks.translation: Although the game has a reasonable number of optional diversions, many things—including time-limited ones—can become unobtainable forever depending on your actions. It is especially troublesome that, if you are not careful, you can miss out on the protagonist’s strongest weapon and the flying vehicle. Incidentally, obtaining this vehicle is also one of the conditions for the best ending.

blocks.source: この時代の作品としては移動速度は遅めでＦＣのＤＱ並。エンカウント率は高めだが『まもりけむり』によって抑制可能。移動魔法のヒュールは入手が中盤で一部キャラしか使えないので不便。そのせいで、序盤は同じ場所を行ったり来たりさせられる。
blocks.translation: For a game from this era, the movement speed is rather slow—about on par with the NES Dragon Quest games. The encounter rate is fairly high, but it can be reduced with the “Maman’s Smoke” item. The movement spell Hyul is inconvenient because it is obtained midway through the game and can only be used by certain characters. As a result, you are forced to go back and forth between the same places during the early game.

blocks.source: 戦闘テンポはやや遅めで、通常攻撃や魔法のアニメーションは若干長い。特に『キャラクターが剣を振る』→『斬撃が敵に当たる』という様に同時に処理すべきアニメーションが順番に表示されるのが気になる。
blocks.translation: The battle pace is somewhat slow, and the animations for normal attacks and spells are slightly long. In particular, it is noticeable that animations that should be processed simultaneously—such as “the character swings a sword” → “the slash hits the enemy”—are displayed one after another.

blocks.source: メニューや店の開閉にそれぞれ１．５秒×２掛かる。メッセージ速度を『はやい』に設定しても、やや遅い文章表示。等々、細かいことだが、同時期のＤＱやＦＦと比較すると、快適性には若干の難有り。
blocks.translation: Opening and closing the menu and shops each takes 1.5 seconds × 2. Even with the message speed set to “Fast,” text appears somewhat slowly. These are minor points, but compared with the Dragon Quest and Final Fantasy games of the same period, the game is slightly lacking in comfort.

blocks.source: ＳＦＣ中後期らしく「綺麗なマップチップ」「可愛らしいキャラクター」「敵味方ともに良く動く戦闘」など、ドット絵のレベルは高い。筆者はこの時代のドット絵がとても好き。
blocks.translation: As one would expect from an SFC game from the middle to later part of its era, the pixel art is highly polished, featuring “beautiful map tiles,” “adorable characters,” and “battles in which both enemies and allies move well.” I really like the pixel art from this era.

blocks.source: フィールド曲や戦闘曲は物語の進行に応じて変化する。特に２番目のフィールド曲は前作の初期フィールド曲のアレンジとなっており、完成度が高い。ただ、最後のフィールド曲など、１ループが短い曲が多く、ここぞという所で尻すぼみに終わるので勿体ない。
blocks.translation: The field and battle themes change as the story progresses. In particular, the second field theme is an arrangement of the previous game’s early field theme and is highly accomplished. However, many songs—including the final field theme—have short loops, ending anticlimactically just when they should make the most impact, which is a shame.

blocks.source: 突出した点は無いが、良い意味で普通な良作ＲＰＧ。客観的な評価を付けると、それほど高い点数にはならないが、個人的には点数以上に好きな作品だったりする。
blocks.translation: It has no outstanding features, but it is a good, solid RPG that is ordinary in the best sense. Judged objectively, it would not receive a particularly high score, but personally, it is one of those games I like more than its score would suggest.

lines.source: ブレスオブファイアシリーズの第２作目。発売日は１９９４／１２／２とＳＦＣでは、やや後期の作品でＦＦ６よりも後発。ちなみに[[LINK_1]]ＧＢＡ版（公式）[[/LINK_1]]も存在する。
